The source PDF is entirely text-based and contains no logos, seals, charts, or other meaningful images. Consequently, the absence of image elements in the HTML output is correct and does not constitute a defect.

Each page of the source PDF appears once and in the correct order in the rendered HTML screenshot. There is no evidence of duplicated blocks of text, headers, or repeated sections beyond what exists in the source document itself (where multiple separate requests use the same form header).
